findings.title: Forgeable _OfficialPermit bypasses official evaluation boundary
findings.evidence: Independent probes: forged _OfficialPermit, forged _VerifiedOfficialAuthorization (own token), matching manifest digest, synthetic+permit all refused with OFFICIAL_AUTHORIZATION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED; REAL via run()/run_from_manifest() refused; marker true only for private token.
findings.remaining_risk: Same-process access to the private token/method is possible (documented Python-level limit). Related defects F13-02, F13-15.
findings.required_next_action: None for the original exploit.

findings.title: Alternate media readers unguarded
findings.evidence: Four named boundaries are guarded immediately before the reader. Other raw-byte readers and guard bypasses remain (F13-01, F13-03, F13-04, F13-05, F13-06, F13-07, F13-13, F13-14).
findings.remaining_risk: Protected media bytes remain readable without AUTH-MEDIA-ACCESS through the paths listed.
findings.required_next_action: Close F13-01/03/04/05 and bring scratch/ under the guard or remove it from the working tree; re-audit.

findings.title: Promotion receipt integrity
findings.evidence: Synthetic receipts: invalid self-hash, wrong review-record hash, wrong input binding, wrong producer, not-ready verdict and future date are rejected. Hand-computed receipt is accepted (documented tamper-evident-only design).
findings.remaining_risk: Receipt is forgeable by anyone with write access and the hash recipe; no expiry/revocation (F13-10).
findings.required_next_action: None for the original finding; see F13-10.

findings.title: Unsafe routine suite / raw-media access
findings.evidence: Runner fail-closed behavior reproduced (exit 3, 4 stale). Cannot execute; 1,802 not reproducible; M12 ran protected-classified files directly.
findings.remaining_risk: No reproducible safe execution; protected-classified tests may have hashed checkpoints (F13-08).
findings.required_next_action: Regenerate classification by the researcher-authorized procedure; resolve F13-08, F13-11, F13-12.

findings.title: Reviewer / trigger / allowlist / identity / timestamp controls
findings.evidence: Code read: allowlist loader (promotion_gate.py:66-137), reviewer allowlist check (:360-370), same-reviewer second-review refusal (:500-517), timebase snapping. Current safe-classified tests pass under guard (262). No independent adversarial probe of duplicate-reviewer or timestamp paths was written, so independent verification is not complete.
findings.reproduction_method: guarded run of test_mission10_second_review, test_phase11_2_stage21_promotion_gate, test_phase5_review_tooling
findings.remaining_risk: Trigger set (RD-043) is a proposal, not adopted policy.
findings.required_next_action: Optional: dedicated adversarial probes in a follow-up audit; researcher decision on RD-043/RD-045.

findings.title: Evaluation input loader reads and hashes in-root media-suffixed sources with no media guard; digest leaks in error
findings.evidence: Loader with a .mov source_path: 0 guard calls, file read in full, SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH message contains the actual SHA-256. Opener tripwire allowlists the function as 'reads the evidence manifest JSON'.
findings.reproduction_method: probe_media.py case I1 (temporary .mov, no repository media)
findings.remaining_risk: Raw media can be read/hashed without AUTH-MEDIA-ACCESS by a caller who controls a manifest location whose root contains the media.
findings.required_next_action: Guard the read (media-suffix and path scope) and stop echoing digests of unverified sources; separate fix instruction required.

findings.title: Public run_from_manifest reads and hashes all declared sources twice before refusing a REAL manifest
findings.evidence: Kwarg omitted or SYNTHETIC with REAL manifest: six source reads then refusal.
findings.remaining_risk: Violates 'refuse before any protected operation' for public APIs.
findings.required_next_action: Decide classification from the manifest header before reading sources.

findings.title: media_guard classifies by suffix of the given path: symlink/hardlink aliases and unlisted suffixes bypass it
findings.evidence: Alias named *.dat or no suffix pointing to repository media returns without exception; .m2ts .ts .3gp .wmv .flv .gif .heic .mxf .dng .mov.bak also return. Readers such as cv2.VideoCapture identify content, not suffix.
findings.reproduction_method: probe_media.py cases D2,D3,G (fake repo paths and temp symlinks only)
findings.remaining_risk: Real-media read via renamed alias; reader-level exploit inferred from guard behavior and not executed against real media.
findings.required_next_action: Resolve before classifying; deny by location (data/raw, repository) rather than suffix; separate fix instruction.

findings.title: Case-insensitive path identity defeats descriptive gate, protected-output check and related guards
findings.evidence: Same directory spelled with different case: descriptive authorization gate returns silently; _checked_output_dir accepts data/Ground_Truth/...; media_guard repo membership is string-based.
findings.remaining_risk: Descriptive replay on real caches without AUTH-DESCRIPTIVE-EVAL-EXEC via a case-variant repo_root (engine not constructed; gate skip demonstrated).
findings.required_next_action: Compare by samefile/inode or case-normalized real path; separate fix instruction.

findings.title: Dashboard /outputs/ and /experiments/ handlers serve any file under the project root via '..' with no guard
findings.evidence: Synthetic tree: /outputs/../data/raw/ds/secret.mov and /outputs/../configs/c.yaml returned 200 with content.
findings.reproduction_method: probe_server.py (patches PROJECT_ROOT to a temp tree)
findings.remaining_risk: Local HTTP client can read raw media, checkpoints and governance files; default bind 127.0.0.1.
findings.required_next_action: Containment + media guard in the handlers; separate fix instruction.

findings.title: scratch/ holds seven unguarded ffmpeg/wave scripts outside every scan root
findings.evidence: analyze_train_events, analyze_forensic_results, analyze_audio, extract_frames, forensic_event_auditor, measure_ground_truth_v7, run_phase2_verification contain ffmpeg/wave.open with no media_guard reference; directory is git-ignored.
findings.remaining_risk: Any process can run them against raw media.
findings.required_next_action: Guard or quarantine; include scratch/ in the opener scan.

findings.title: Guard denial swallowed by broad except in image manifest/validator
findings.evidence: validator._check_image returns ('unreadable_image', ...); _read_dimensions returns None; manifest.py records excluded_unreadable. Reads stay blocked.
findings.remaining_risk: Unauthorized caller gets an empty/partial manifest and misleading diagnostics.
findings.required_next_action: Let MediaAccessAuthorizationError propagate.

findings.title: Mission 12 ran protected-access-classified test files directly; 'no checkpoint hashed' unverifiable and probably wrong
findings.evidence: Manifest classes test_phase12_governance.py as MODEL_CHECKPOINT_ACCESS and test_phase12_official_replay.py as PROCESSED_DATA_ACCESS; they call assess_official_phase12_readiness(REPO_ROOT) which hashes three production checkpoints. M12 plain pytest list includes both. This audit did not run them.
findings.remaining_risk: Provenance claims in M12 report and manuscript may be false.
findings.required_next_action: Researcher to review the Mission 12 session; correct the claim.

findings.title: Readiness gate hashes protected checkpoints before and independent of authorization; no checkpoint-access control
findings.evidence: frozen-config block always runs verify_checkpoint_integrity; tripwire allowlists compute_file_sha256 as 'weights, not media'.
findings.remaining_risk: run_official on the real repo hashes checkpoints then refuses for missing EVAL-AUTH.
findings.required_next_action: Researcher decision whether checkpoint hashing needs authorization; document.

findings.title: EVAL-AUTH and promotion receipt have no expiry/revocation; receipt is hand-computable
findings.evidence: EVAL-AUTH key set has no expires_at_utc/revoked/status; receipt R0 accepted, R7 (5-year-old) accepted, R8 revoked flag ignored. Mission 12 design note claims expiration/revocation is rechecked.
findings.remaining_risk: A granted EVAL-AUTH cannot be revoked or aged out except by deleting/editing files.
findings.required_next_action: Researcher decision on schema; correct the M12 design note.
